summary: Backend API and end-to-end discovery/admin CRUD checks completed. Public APIs and CRUD persistence passed; browser workflows passed except admin session restoration after reload.

integration_issues.issue: After successful login, reloading /admin renders the login screen even though the valid httpOnly access_token cookie remains. App initializes user state to null and never calls /api/auth/me.

action_items: Initialize admin auth state from /api/auth/me (with loading state) so a valid cookie restores /admin after reload.
Re-run the admin reload/logout flow after the auth-state fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend auth is only held in React memory; this undermines the backend httpOnly JWT session on refresh and can strand an authenticated administrator at the login form.
Discovery useEffect has exhaustive-deps warnings for page, params, and search; clean up dependencies to avoid future stale or duplicate requests.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_ event through API tests and one TEST_UI_Event_Atlas event through the browser CRUD flow; no test data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discovery seeded cards, featured cards, search, category/industry filtering, detail page, unauthenticated admin route, login, admin list, create/edit/delete confirmation, logout, mobile layout, and API CRUD were exercised. Search/filter test initially used an incorrect expectation while retaining the active search term; this was a test assertion issue, not an app failure.
